title: Slate sport-tab and Game lines/Props switches show no skeleton and cause big layout shifts (CLS 0.14 and 0.27)
persona: User on slow 3G (400 kbps, 400 ms RTT, 4x CPU)
steps: Tap CBB tab, then tap Props
expected: Skeleton/placeholder while the new slate loads; CLS < 0.1 per navigation
actual: Tab nba->cbb: skeleton never shown, 1486 ms, 36.4 KB RSC payload, layout shift 0.1429 (footer pushed down when 76 CBB rows replace 3 NBA rows). Lines->Props toggle: skeleton never shown, 628 ms, shift 0.2668 (footer + 'P.text-ink' empty state). The old list stays on screen until the new one swaps in, so the page appears frozen for 0.6-1.5 s. Lighthouse initial-load CLS is 0, so this only shows on client navigation.
evidence: nav.js output: 'tab nba->cbb' cls 0.1429 shifts [FOOTER]; 'cbb Props toggle' cls 0.2668
suspected_area: slate/loading.tsx only triggers on route-segment change, not searchParams change; need Suspense with key={sport+view} or min-height on content
